notes:
{煽|あお}る has three main meanings: physical fanning, inciting emotions/actions, and aggressive driving.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (る-verb with ら-row conjugation)
- Transitive

WRITING:
- {煽|あお}る uses {煽|あお} (fan, incite)
- Often written in hiragana in casual contexts

SENSE 1 (FANNING):
- Physical action of creating airflow
- Common with fire, fans, curtains

SENSE 2 (INCITING):
- Very common in news and social media contexts
- Usually negative connotation
- Common objects: ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧ (anxiety), ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧ (conflict), ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧ (emotions)

SENSE 3 (TAILGATING):
- Modern driving-related usage
- {煽|あお}り⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (tailgating, aggressive driving) became a legal term
- Social issue that gained attention in 2010s Japan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{煽|あお}る (incite anxiety)
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{煽|あお}る (stoke fear)
- ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{煽|あお}る (stir up conflict)
- {煽|あお}り⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (tailgating)
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{煽|あお}る (provoke emotions)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{煽|あお}り→煽り：10928_aori⟧ (noun: incitement; tailgating)
- {煽動|せんどう} (agitation, instigation)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in news media for sense 2, everyday speech for sense 3.
